tokens.nameHint: Letters, digits and . _ - (up to 64 characters). Must be unique.
tokens.nameInvalid: Use up to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' for the name.
tokens.validDaysHint: Leave empty to use the default.
tokens.validDaysInvalid: Valid days must be a whole number of 1 or more.
tokens.ruleHint: Applied when the agent connects for the first time.
tokens.reissueNote: Reissuing invalidates the previous value. The agent must be re-initialized with the new value.
tokens.unbindConfirm: Unbind token {{name}} from its instance ID? It will be bound to the next agent that connects.
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke token {{name}}? Agents using it will no longer be able to connect. This cannot be undone.
tokens.initCommandHint: Run it on the monitored host. It asks for the token without showing what you type.
tokens.initThenStart: After initializing, start the agent with:
tokens.fullValueNote: The full value is shown only until you close this dialog. Copy it now, then enter it when agent init asks for the token.

suppressions.emptyIsAny: Leave empty to match every user.
suppressions.wildcardHint: Use * to match any string. Leave empty to match everything.
suppressions.deleteConfirm: Delete this suppression? Matching detections will be notified again.

ruleEditor.usersHint: Used for execution, denied operation, read and writable state monitoring.
ruleEditor.scanIntervalHint: Seconds between writable state scans. 0 means not specified (default 3600).
ruleEditor.condExec: Enabled when OS users and a category are set.
ruleEditor.condDenied: Enabled when OS users and a category are set.
ruleEditor.condRead: Enabled when OS users, directories to watch and a category are set.
ruleEditor.condNetwork: Enabled when executables to watch and a category are set.
ruleEditor.condWritable: Enabled when a scan base and a category are set.
ruleEditor.condExecFile: Enabled when a scan base, allowed write paths, extensions and the category elsewhere are set.
ruleEditor.allowedPathsHint: Directories where writes are allowed, such as upload folders. Enter directory names relative to the scan base, e.g. uploads or data/files; they match at any depth below the base.
ruleEditor.legitHint: Path (directory names relative to the scan base, e.g. app/cache), extensions (comma separated, at least one) and category (required).
ruleEditor.jsonHint: Edit the JSON directly. Changes reach the form as soon as the JSON is valid.
ruleEditor.jsonProblems: These parts are not valid rule content. They would be lost, so the JSON is not taken over:
ruleEditor.jsonDuplicateKey: {{path}}: the key is written more than once (only the last value would be kept)
ruleEditor.jsonBlocked: Saving and switching to the form are not possible until the JSON is corrected.

rules.commentHint: Describe what changed in this version.
rules.applyBuiltinDisabled: The built-in agent (central) is not listed because it is disabled in the configuration.
rules.unassignConfirm: Take the monitoring rule "{{rule}}" away from {{agent}}? At its next check the agent removes the audit rules it loaded and its rules file, and reports that nothing is applied. The host is not monitored until a rule is applied again.
rules.unassigned: The rule was removed. The agent removes its audit rules at its next check.
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete rule {{name}}? All versions will be deleted.
rules.deleteInUse: The rule is applied to agents and cannot be deleted.
rules.editNote: Saving creates version v{{version}}. Agents receive it only after you apply it.
rules.newDescription: Combine templates, or start from an empty rule.
rules.fromEmptyNote: Creates a rule with empty content and opens the editor.
rules.templatesOrderHint: The selection order is shown as a number. For conflicting fields the first selected template wins by default.
rules.conflictsHint: These fields differ between templates. Choose which template's value to use.
rules.mergedContentNote: Conflicting fields are shown with the first template's value. The rule will use the values chosen above.

templates.chooseBuiltin: Choose the built-in template to copy.
templates.chooseRule: Choose a rule and a version.
templates.builtinReadOnly: Built-in templates cannot be edited or deleted. Copy one into a new template instead.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Manage the accounts that can log in to this console.
accounts.displayNameHint: Name shown on the screens, up to {{max}} characters.
accounts.changeEmailNote: The change is applied at once, without a verification code. The account is logged out on every device and no browser stays trusted.
accounts.changeOwnEmailWarning: This is your own account: you will be logged out and must log in again with the new address.
accounts.disableConfirm: Disable {{name}}? The account will no longer be able to log in.

guide.noCentralHosts: No host name for the agents is set yet, so the commands show <host>. Add the host name or IP address that the agents use to connect to the central to "Server certificate names" in System settings, then use that name in place of <host>.

config.title: System settings
config.applyNote: Items marked "Immediate" take effect as soon as they are saved. Items marked "After restart" take effect when the central is restarted.
config.restartTitle: Takes effect when the central is restarted
config.immediateTitle: Takes effect as soon as it is saved
config.pendingTitle: Restart the central to apply the saved values
config.pendingBody: Saved but not in effect yet: {{items}}
config.savedRestart: Settings saved. Some changes take effect after the central restarts.

web_listen.label: Browser listen address
web_listen.hint: IP address and port of the browser screens (HTTP).

agent_listen.label: Agent and management listen address
agent_listen.hint: IP address and port for the agents (HTTPS).

server_names.label: Server certificate names
server_names.hint: Host names and IP addresses the agents use to connect. 127.0.0.1, ::1 and localhost are always included. A new server certificate is issued within a minute.

workers.label: Workers
workers.hint: Requests processed at the same time (up to 64).

queue_timeout_sec.label: Queue timeout (seconds)
queue_timeout_sec.hint: A waiting request is refused after this time.

token_valid_days.label: Token validity (days)
token_valid_days.hint: Default validity of issued and renewed tokens.

token_renew_before_days.label: Renew tokens before (days)
token_renew_before_days.hint: A token is renewed automatically when fewer days than this remain.

default_check_interval_sec.label: Default check interval (seconds)
default_check_interval_sec.hint: Check interval of agents without a monitoring rule.

retention_days.label: Retention (days)
retention_days.hint: Detections and records of rejected connections older than this are deleted.

session_remember_days.label: Kept login (days)
session_remember_days.hint: Lifetime of a login with "Keep me logged in" (up to 365). Applies to new logins.

two_step_trust_days.label: Trusted browser period (days)
two_step_trust_days.hint: A browser marked as trusted at the login code step needs no code for this many days (1 to 365). Applies at once.

notify_dedupe_hours.label: Duplicate suppression (hours)
notify_dedupe_hours.hint: The same detection of the same agent is not notified again within this time.

notify_max_lines.label: Maximum lines
notify_max_lines.hint: Maximum detection lines in one mail.

notify_subject_prefix.label: Subject prefix
notify_subject_prefix.hint: Added at the start of the subject.

smtp_host.label: SMTP server
smtp_host.hint: While empty, no notifications are sent and no verification codes are used (login, e-mail address changes and changes of command sets). Notifications are sent only when the server and sender are set and at least one account is chosen as a notification recipient.

smtp_port.label: Port
smtp_port.hint: 587, 465 or 25 by default depending on the security.

smtp_auth.label: Authentication
smtp_auth.hint: Log in to the SMTP server.

smtp_password.label: Password
smtp_password.hint: Enter a new value to change it. The stored value is never shown.

smtp_from.label: Sender
smtp_from.hint: Sender address. Required for notifications and verification codes.

smtp_helo_name.label: HELO name
smtp_helo_name.hint: Name sent in HELO/EHLO. localhost when empty.

recipients.title: Notification recipients
recipients.hint: Choose the accounts that receive the notification mails. The mails are sent to the e-mail addresses of the chosen accounts.
recipients.count: Accounts that receive the notification mails: {{count}}
recipients.none: No account receives the notification mails, so no notification mails are sent.
recipients.disabledTitle: Disabled accounts keep the choice but receive nothing while they are disabled.

stepUp.title: Confirm with a verification code
stepUp.why: Changing command sets needs a verification code mailed to your e-mail address. After the code is accepted, the change is made, and further changes need no code for a while.
stepUp.sent: A verification code was sent to your e-mail address.
stepUp.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from the mail. It is valid for 10 minutes.
stepUp.invalidCode: The code is not correct. Check the mail and enter it again.
stepUp.expired: The code has expired or was entered wrongly too often. Send a new code.
stepUp.cancelled: Nothing was changed because no verification code was entered.

commandSets.title: Command sets
commandSets.empty: This agent has no command sets yet.
commandSets.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its run history is kept until the retention period ends. A run request not yet delivered is discarded.
commandSets.valid: The command set has no problems.
commandSets.nameTaken: Another command set of this agent has this name.
commandSets.notFound: The command set was not found. It may have been deleted.
commandSets.requested: Requested a run of {{name}}. The agent runs it after its next connection.
commandSets.requestConflict: A run of this command set is already requested.
commandSets.hostZone: Schedules use the local time of the host ({{zone}}).
commandSets.hostZoneUnknown: Schedules use the local time of the host. The agent has not reported its time zone yet.
commandSets.notDelivered: The agent has not received the current command sets yet. It receives them at its next connection.
commandSets.agentProblems: The agent did not accept this command set

patternProblem.timeout: Pattern {{n}} took too long and was stopped.
patternProblem.invalid: Pattern {{n}} could not be used on the agent.

commandSets.importHint: Copies command sets of an agent (also this one) to this agent, with all their settings including the OS user and the working directory. Each copy can be given a new name.
commandSets.importNone: This agent has no command sets.
commandSets.nameClash: This name is already used. Enter another name.

purposeHint.collect_output: Values are taken from the console output and shown in the command results.
purposeHint.run_only: The commands are run and their results recorded; no values are taken.

runModeHint.manual: Runs only when "Run now" is used.
runModeHint.schedule: Runs at the times below. "Run now" can also be used.

scheduleKind.once: Once at a date and time

onProblemsHint.stop: When this command ends in a failure or an error, the remaining commands are not run.
onProblemsHint.continue_on_failure: After a failure the next command runs; after an error the remaining commands are not run.
onProblemsHint.continue_always: The next command runs whatever the result of this one.

summary.manual: Runs only when requested with "Run now".
summary.once: Runs once at {{at}} (time of this browser).
summary.onceUnset: Runs once at the date and time to be entered.
summary.everyHour: Runs every hour on the hour {{zone}}.
summary.hostZoneUnknown: (host time; the time zone is not reported yet)

editor.osUserHint: The commands run as this user. The agent runs as {{user}}.
editor.osUserUnknown: The commands run as this user. The agent has not reported the user it runs as yet.
editor.workDirHint: Absolute path where every command starts. When empty, the home directory of the OS user.
editor.workDirPlaceholder: Home directory of the OS user
editor.onceAtHint: In the time of this browser.
editor.hostTimeHint: In the local time of the host.
editor.keepRunsHint: Older runs beyond this number are deleted (1 to 10000).
editor.joinerHint: How several values of one group name are joined.
editor.commandsHint: The commands run one after another in this order.
editor.pasteHint: Lines that bash would continue on the next line (a backslash at the end, an open quote or parenthesis, if ... fi, a here-document and so on) stay one command with their line breaks. Every other line becomes one command. Blank lines and comment lines are not added, and the commands are added after the existing ones.
editor.pasteNone: There is no command in the text yet.
editor.pasteMore: Only the first {{shown}} are shown here. The other {{count}} are added too.
editor.commandLineHint: Run by bash exactly as written. Pipes, redirections, cd and several lines can be used; a cd affects only this command.
editor.noErrorCodes: Every exit code is a success or a failure.
editor.codesOverlap: These exit codes are both success and failure codes: {{codes}}
editor.timeoutHint: 1 to 86400. The command is stopped when it runs longer.
editor.lineLimitHint: Lines of this command's part of the values (1 to 10000).
editor.patternsHint: Regular expressions applied to the whole console output in this order. Each needs a named group such as (?<name>...); what the groups capture are the values. Without patterns, the console output itself is the value.
editor.noPatterns: No patterns: the console output is used as the value.

account.last_admin_delete: the last enabled administrator cannot be deleted
account.last_admin_disable: the last enabled administrator cannot be disabled
account.last_admin_role: the last enabled administrator cannot be changed to viewer
account.notify_invalid: notify must be true or false
account.role_invalid: role must be admin or viewer

auth.step_up_code_expired: the verification code has expired or was entered wrongly too often; request a new code
auth.step_up_required: re-authentication required: request a verification code by mail and enter it to change command sets

command.import_conflicts: these names are already used in the monitored target or repeated in the import: {{names}}
command.import_item_not_found: command set {{set}} not found in the source
command.import_select: items: choose at least one command set to import
command.name_taken: name: another command set of this monitored target has this name
command.request_not_discardable: only a run request that was not yet delivered to the agent can be discarded
command.request_pending: this command set already has a run request that has not been answered

spec.at_format_local: {{value}} is not a date and time such as 2026-12-01 03:00
spec.at_format_offset: {{value}} is not a date and time with a UTC offset such as 2026-12-01T03:00:00+09:00
spec.at_required: a date and time is required
spec.code_b_unused: is used only by the kind range
spec.code_kind: must be single, range, min or max
spec.codes_overlap: the success codes ({{success}}) and the failure codes ({{failure}}) must not overlap
spec.command_line_nul: must not contain a NUL byte
spec.commands_required: at least one command is required
spec.minute_required: a minute from 0 to 59 is required
spec.not_object: invalid command set: the definition must be a JSON object
spec.on_problems: must be stop, continue_on_failure or continue_always
spec.one_object: invalid command set: only one JSON object is allowed
spec.os_user_space: must not contain white space or control characters
spec.patterns_run_only: are used only when purpose is collect_output
spec.schedule_kind: must be once, weekly, daily, every_hours, every_minutes or hourly_at
spec.schedule_null: must be null when run_mode is manual
spec.schedule_required: is required when run_mode is schedule
spec.text_control: must not contain control characters other than line breaks and tabs
spec.time_of_day: must be a time of day from 00:00 to 23:59
spec.weekdays_required: at least one weekday is required
spec.work_dir_clean: must be a clean path (no empty, . or .. parts and no trailing slash)
spec.work_dir_nul: must not contain NUL or line breaks
spec.wrong_type: invalid command set: {{field}} must be {{expected}}, not {{found}}

config.listen_ip: {{field}}: the address must be an IP address
config.renew_before: token_renew_before_days must be less than token_valid_days
config.server_name_invalid: server_names: {{value}} is not a host name or IP address
config.smtp_from: smtp.from must be one mail address
config.smtp_host: smtp.host must be a host name or IP address
config.smtp_security: smtp.security must be starttls, tls or none

detail.admin_recovered_cli: administrator recovered on the central host
detail.email_code_failed: the code for the change to {{email}} could not be sent: {{cause}}
detail.first_admin_cli: first administrator created on the central host
detail.login_code_failed: the login code for a login from {{host}} could not be sent: {{cause}}

request_ended_why.expired: it reached the agent after its expiry
request_ended_why.unknown_set: the agent does not hold this command set

detail.request_not_delivered: request {{request}} was not delivered to the agent within {{expiry}}
detail.step_up_code_failed: the re-authentication code for a request from {{host}} could not be sent: {{cause}}

pattern.ambiguous_name: group numbers are ambiguous because the name {{name}} is used for more than one group
pattern.backref_digits: {{ref}}: write references to groups with at most two digits and octal escapes with three octal digits
pattern.backref_open: {{ref}} refers to group {{n}}, which is still open at that point
pattern.backref_undefined: {{ref}} refers to group {{n}}, which is not defined before it
pattern.balancing: balancing groups such as {{form}} are not supported
pattern.comment_backslash: a # comment that ends with a backslash is not supported
pattern.comment_group_backslash: a comment (?#...) that ends with a backslash is not supported
pattern.cond_missing: (?({{n}})...) refers to group {{n}}, which does not exist
pattern.empty_group: the empty group (?) is not supported
pattern.named_group_required: must have at least one named group such as (?P<name>...) or (?<name>...)
pattern.named_ref_open: (?P={{name}}) refers to a group that is still open at that point
pattern.named_ref_undefined: (?P={{name}}) refers to a group name that is not defined before it
pattern.numbered_group: numbered groups such as (?<1>...) are not supported; give the group a name
pattern.numbering: the groups of this pattern cannot be numbered in the order of their opening parentheses; simplify the pattern
pattern.option_n: the option n (explicit capture) is not supported
pattern.quote: \{{char}} is not supported (quoting with \Q...\E); escape each special character with a backslash instead

rule.in_use: the rule is applied to an agent and cannot be deleted
rule.name_taken: a rule with this name already exists

suppression.condition_required: at least one condition is required

template.builtin_name: the name of a built-in template cannot be used
template.name_invalid: template name must be 1-64 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -
template.name_taken: a template with this name already exists

token.name_invalid: token name must be 1-64 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -
token.name_taken: a token with this name already exists
